en.bdb: Making of the virtue from the evil

verses.gurmukhi: ਅਉਗੁਣ ਕੀਤੇ ਗੁਣ ਕਰੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਉ ਤਰੋਵਰ ਹੰਦਾ।
verses.translit_en: aaugun keete gun karai sahaj subhaau tarovar ha(n)dhaa|

en.bdb: The tree being in equipoise does good even to the evil doer.

verses.gurmukhi: ਵਢਣ ਵਾਲਾ ਛਾਉ ਬਹਿ ਚੰਗੇ ਦਾ ਮੰਦਾ ਚਿਤਵੰਦਾ।
verses.translit_en: vaddan vaalaa chhaau beh cha(n)ge dhaa ma(n)dhaa chitava(n)dhaa|

en.bdb: The tree cutter sits under the shade of the same and thinks evil of that benevolent one.

verses.gurmukhi: ਫਲ ਦੇ ਵਟ ਵਗਾਇਆ ਵਢਣ ਵਾਲੇ ਤਾਰਿ ਤਰੰਦਾ।
verses.translit_en: fal dhe vaT vagaiaa vaddan vaale taar tara(n)dhaa|

en.bdb: It gives fruits to the stone throwers and boat to the cutters to get them across.

verses.gurmukhi: ਬੇਮੁਖ ਫਲ ਨਾ ਪਾਇਦੇ ਸੇਵਕ ਫਲ ਅਣਗਣਤ ਫਲੰਦਾ।
verses.translit_en: bemukh fal naa paidhe sevak fal anaganat fala(n)dhaa|

en.bdb: The individuals opposed to the Gum do not get fruit and the servants receive infinite reward.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਸੇਵਕ ਸੇਵ ਕਰੰਦਾ।
verses.translit_en: gurmukh viralaa jaaneeaai sevak sevak sev kara(n)dhaa|

en.bdb: Any rare gurmukh is known in this world who serves the servants of the Lord's servants.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜਗੁ ਜੋਹਾਰੇ ਚੰਦ ਨੋ ਸਾਇਰ ਲਹਰਿ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਵਧੰਦਾ।
verses.translit_en: jag johaare cha(n)dh no sair lahar ana(n)dh vadha(n)dhaa|

en.bdb: The second day moon is saluted by all and the ocean also becoming glad throws its waves towards it.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤੇਰਾ ਜਗੁ ਤਿਸ ਦਾ ਬੰਦਾ ॥੧੧॥
verses.translit_en: jo teraa jag tis dhaa ba(n)dhaa ||11||

en.bdb: 0 Lord! the whole world becomes his who is yours own.
